mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (login_id, user_name, password, email, birth_date, nickname, address, address2, phone, gender, member_type, created_date, updated_date, profile, member_status, zipcode, activity_point) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{email}, #{birthDate}, #{nickname}, #{address}, #{address2}, #{phone}, #{gender}, #{memberType}, NOW(), NOW(), #{profile}, '가입중', #{zipcode}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET last_login_date = NOW() WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
UPDATE user SET profile = #{profile}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
UPDATE user SET ${fieldName} = #{fieldValue}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE user SET zipcode = #{zipcode}, address = #{address}, address2 = #{address2}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE user SET password = #{encodedNewPassword} WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
UPDATE user SET password = #{encodedNewPassword} WHERE email = #{email}
UPDATE user SET activity_point = activity_point + #{points}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE nickname = #{nickname}

SELECT member_id AS memberId, user_name AS userName, nickname, login_id AS loginId, email, password, zipcode, address, address2, phone, gender, birth_date AS birthDate, member_type AS memberType, grade_id AS gradeId, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate, last_login_date AS lastLoginDate, profile, activity_point AS activityPoint, member_status AS memberStatus FROM user WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT login_id FROM user WHERE user_name = #{userName} AND email = #{email}

SELECT member_id AS memberId, user_name AS userName, nickname, login_id AS loginId, email, password, zipcode, address, address2, phone, gender, birth_date AS birthDate, member_type AS memberType, grade_id AS gradeId, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate, last_login_date AS lastLoginDate, profile, activity_point AS activityPoint, member_status AS memberStatus FROM user WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT nickname, profile, activity_point AS activityPoint FROM user ORDER BY activity_point DESC LIMIT 5

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_audit_log (login_id, ip_address, user_agent, status, fail_reason, attempt_at) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{status}, #{failReason}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_audit_log WHERE ip_address = #{ipAddress} AND login_id = #{loginId} AND status = 'FAIL' AND attempt_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)

SELECT audit_no as auditNo, login_id as loginId, ip_address as ipAddress, user_agent as userAgent, status, fail_reason as failReason, DATE_FORMAT(attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as attemptAt FROM login_audit_log ORDER BY audit_no DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as successCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 END) as failCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'BLOCKED' THEN 1 END) as blockCnt FROM login_audit_log WHERE DATE(attempt_at) = CURDATE()
